notes: EHSHook(IPoolManager manager, address token) takes $poolManager (Ethereum mainnet 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90) and $token. Deploy directly by CREATE2 with low 14 address bits 0x20cc. Static 1.25% LP fee plus 2% of filled IMD as ERC-6909 claims; specified-side reserves reconcile in afterSwap and excess becomes a claim owned by the calling swapper/router. Routers pass abi.encode(outputRecipient) for rewards; empty or malformed context falls back to the calling swapper without blocking swaps. Buys of at least 10 IMD record 1% of filled IMD, capped by unowed accrued fees, claimable only by/to the beneficiary. No in-swap reward transfers, owner or upgrades. Factory mints all 1e27 units to itself and distributes 90% liquidity / 10% swarm; initialPrice is provenance only.
